design_description: A modern interpretation of the Legacy template, using geometric striping to create a bold and recognizable club identity. The deep black base is intersected by a large green cross structure formed by vertical and horizontal bands, giving the jersey a strong architectural presence. Thin central pinstripes add refinement and help modernize the otherwise classic layout. White collar, sleeve cuffs, crest, and sponsor graphics provide sharp contrast and keep the design clean and highly legible. Overall, the kit feels confident, structured, and timeless — blending traditional football heritage with a contemporary minimalist aesthetic.
